The Chinese characters for Kenneth

As a transliteration, Kenneth is usually written 肯尼思 (Kěn ní sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

肯
Kěn
willing
尼
ní
nun (transliteration)
思
sī
think, thought

Origin and meaning

Kenneth comes from Scottish and means “born of fire, or handsome”.

About the name Kenneth

A Scottish name of kings, from the Gaelic Cináed.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Kenneth carries the meaning “born of fire, or handsome” and looks striking in brush strokes.
